items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: Jimmy Pupa was the guy I got first, the first trumpet player... and he says, 'Well, you've got to get Dodo Marmarosa on piano,' and I said, 'Okay, we'll get Dodo,' when the piano thing came open.

ctx.x: Jimmy Pupa was the guy I got first, the first trumpet player, and he'd played first trumpet with Krupa, so I got him. You know, we used to steal people in those days. And he says, 'Well, you've got to get Dodo Marmarosa on piano,' and I said, 'Okay, we'll get Dodo,' when the piano thing came open. Then we got Buddy De Franco on there. Well, that band -- we went in the Strand Theater in New York, and they were completely out of hand. It --
